activity.notes: Fujiwara no Michinaga became sesshō (regent) for the young Emperor Go-Ichijō in 1016 and relinquished the regency to his son Yorimichi in 1017. ATLAS uses this short formal regency rather than the much broader but less sharply bounded period of his de facto dominance at the Heian court; he is not mislabeled as kampaku.
